title: Every Reason the Black Mamba Is Africa's Scariest Snake
alt_titles: Why the Black Mamba Warns You Three Times Before It Kills

thumbnail_brief: A black mamba reared up with its head in the top third of the frame, inky-black mouth open with small fangs aimed at Doug, narrow hood, with tiny red-capped Doug standing right in front of the dark hole of a termite mound behind it and the words IT'S GOING HOME, so the title says why Africa fears it and the thumbnail shows the twist that Doug is in its doorway (no BLACK, MAMBA, SNAKE, AFRICA or SCARIEST on the image; no dripping fangs, blood, bite marks or cute snake face).
description:
The black mamba is the snake Africa fears most, yet the one that seems to chase you at 20 km/h is usually just heading home, and you are standing in its doorway. Doug ignores every warning it gives, from the head lift and the hood to the second strike, dendrotoxins, the mambalgin painkiller, and finally a bite a day's ride from antivenom.

Which animal should Doug stop ignoring next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
